docs(arc42): no single app, no progress, no foreign ids in the architecture

## Intent

The architecture should describe the system on its own and stay true over time. The Mathe-Karte is one implementation of an archetype, maybe not even a good one, so it is not named. Progress wording and ids of other documents go stale. Only direct cross-references, such as goals derived from the platform design, use deep links.

## Key changes

- The Mathe-Karte and its author no longer appear; the explainer archetype is described by what it is.
- Progress wording, plan and issue ids and platform-design ids are gone; direct cross-references are deep links to rendered pages.
- Decisions without progress: the owner runs the review, the tooling sends nothing, every report is bound to a commit.
